The Statement assumes an integral Seifert matrix, not an arbitrary even-order integer matrix. The cited metabolic-lattice definition requires a unimodular skew part, and an actual knot matrix has that property. Thus V=0_2 is inadmissible. The wider domain on which S-equivalence is defined does not remove this lemma's hypothesis. The integral basis change c=-J^{-1}(x-y) yields J plus a unimodular skew block in both cases, and the displayed primitive half-rank diagonal subgroup annihilates E_i plus (-V).
